This indicates that the company generates more profit from shareholders' equity compared to its competitors. [Bull] The operating margin has improved by 2 percentage points in the most recent quarter, reaching 14% from 12% in the year-ago quarter. This improvement is a positive indicator of operational efficiency and profitability. [Bear] However, ROSSTECH's ROE (Return on Equity) over the last three years stands at only 10.2%, which is below the sector benchmark of 10.97%. This suggests that the company may not be effectively utilizing its equity to generate profits relative to its peers. [Conceded: E51] The evidence from Screener flags a negative, indicating a low return on equity over the last three years at 10.2%, which is below the sector benchmark of 10.97%. This concession acknowledges that this aspect of ROSSTECH's performance may be underperforming in comparison to its peers. In summary, while ROSSTECH appears undervalued based on its P/E ratio and ROE compared to the sector average, concerns regarding its historical return on equity suggest potential areas for improvement.
